combo_label: The Village Fete × Butterflies & Moths × Stonehenge & Standing Stones

entries.clue: Boiled fruit and sugar set in a jar, sold with a gingham cover and a hand-written label
Long seasonal journey north, as made by the Painted Lady up from Africa
White-robed solstice celebrant of an order far younger than the monument
Chalk-cut trench of the first enclosure, its main bank heaped inside it
Solitary leaning block outside the circle, near which the solstice sun comes up
Rough estimate written on a numbered sheet, a coin in the tin, and nearest one wins
Cross-shaped setting of gneiss slabs standing on the Isle of Lewis
Hard silcrete boulder from West Woods near Marlborough, dressed into the outer ring
Coiled drinking straw a butterfly unrolls to reach the sweetness in a flower
Steel spikes hammered into the field so guy ropes can hold the canvas taut
Heraldic white fur, and also a white moth freckled all over with black
Village competition half of the day, with classes for baking, flowers and honey
